entries.positive_observation: The complete derived RGBA visibly preserves the approved parent art and the source's right-facing near-profile head and rightward gaze. The compact yellow mascot retains green-ringed solid black eyes, one restrained closed mouth, and no human nose, ears or skin. The dark olive peaked cap keeps its shiny visor, gold piping/cord, upper eagle and separate lower red-centered wreath/cockade. Short dark-brown temple hair, narrow sideburns and both brown eyebrows remain; the chin is clean-shaven and there are no glasses or moustache. The original upright crop, directional modeling and visor shadow remain recognizable. Two red gold-emblem collar patches, gold shoulder boards, white pointed shirt collar, dark tie and one black-and-silver neck cross remain without duplicated ornaments. The rounded chin has a short broad transition into a naturally fitted collar without pinching, floating cloth, clipping or a cream bib. The pale gray-olive/greige backplate remains complete with no frame, note, halo or replacement scene.
entries.alpha_decision: The existing derived repair is accepted, not represented as a native transparent return. Read-only recomputation confirmed that the parent RGB pixels and derived RGB channels are identical, and that the source alpha resized with BILINEAR exactly equals the derived alpha; resized alpha raw-byte SHA-256 is 11e122a90e29c4446b6c237e34e49cbf168d719980366098d97c5453f58620c1. Source, resized and output corner alpha arrays are all [255,255,255,255]. Source and returned alpha extrema are [255,255], and all 4205568 derived pixels have alpha 255. Actual full white/cyan/alpha viewing shows a continuous opaque backplate and solid clothing with no holes, matte, halo or backing loss; cyan strips are sheet letterboxing. No additional repair was performed.
entries.visible_limitations: The fine cap and collar insignia, exact shoulder-board embroidery and small neck-cross interior cannot be resolved completely at 156x210. Their visible counts, positions and broad shapes were checked without inventing finer detail; those resolution limits are not rejection grounds.
